summary: Built 3 demo pages for TaskFlow, a project management SaaS product. Created a landing page with hero section, stats bar, 3 feature highlight cards, and CTA. Created 2 feature detail pages (Project Tracking and Team Analytics) with realistic sample data tables populated from a global JSON data file. Updated the base layout with full navigation menu and multi-column footer. Added responsive CSS with media queries for mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), and desktop (>1024px) viewports. Included SVG placeholder images, mobile hamburger menu, and accessibility features (ARIA labels, semantic HTML, alt text, scope attributes).
